title: Rama kills Ravana
introduction: On the advice of Matali the charioteer, Rama employs on Ravana, a mystic missile presided over by Brahma. That arrow penetrates Ravana's heart and kills him. Ravana falls down dead from his chariot to the earth.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे अष्टोत्तरशरतमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 108th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
अथ सस्मारयामास मातली राघवं तदा |
अजानन्निव किं वीर त्वमेनमनुवर्तसे
verses.iast:
atha sasmārayāmāsa mātalī rāghavaṃ tadā |
ajānanniva kiṃ vīra tvamenamanuvartase
verses.translation: Thereupon, Matali refreshed the memory of Rama as follows: "O the valiant one! Why are you still carrying out the battle with Ravana as though you are unaware (of how to dispose of him)?

glosses.meaning: as though you are unaware (of how to dispose of him)?

verses.devanagari:
विसृजास्मै वधाय त्वमस्त्रं पैतामहं प्रभो |
विनाशकालः कथितो यः सुरैः सोऽद्य वर्तते
verses.iast:
visṛjāsmai vadhāya tvamastraṃ paitāmahaṃ prabho |
vināśakālaḥ kathito yaḥ suraiḥ so'dya vartate
verses.translation: "O lord! You can employ a mystic missile presided over by Brahma the lord of creation. The time for his destruction has come now, as expressed by the celestials."

glosses.meaning: presided over by Brahma the lord of creation

verses.devanagari:
ततः संस्मारितो रामस्तेन वाक्येन मातलेः |
जग्राह स शरं दीप्तं निःश्वसन्तमिवोरगम्
यं तस्मैन् प्रथमं प्रादादगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः |
ब्रह्मदत्तं महाबाणममोघं युधि वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ saṃsmārito rāmastena vākyena mātaleḥ |
jagrāha sa śaraṃ dīptaṃ niḥśvasantamivoragam
yaṃ tasmain prathamaṃ prādādagastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ |
brahmadattaṃ mahābāṇamamoghaṃ yudhi vīryavān
verses.translation: Then, the valiant Rama, who was reminded thus by Matali, took hold of a blazing arrow, which was given by Brahma and which in turn was given to him by the glorious sage, Agastya earlier in the battle-field and which looked like a hissing serpent.

glosses.meaning: and which looked like a hissing serpent.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा |
दत्तं सुरपतेः पूर्वं त्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.iast:
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ pūrvamindrārthamamitaujasā |
dattaṃ surapateḥ pūrvaṃ trilokajayakāṇ^kṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Having been made formerly for Indra, the lord of celestials by Brahma, the lord of creation of infinite strength, it was bestowed in the past on the ruler of gods, who was desirous of conquering the three worlds.

glosses.meaning: by Brahma the lord of creation
who was desirous of conquering the three worlds.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य वाजेषु पवनः फले पावकबास्करौ |
शरीरमाकाशमयं गौरवे मेरुमन्दरौ
verses.iast:
yasya vājeṣu pavanaḥ phale pāvakabāskarau |
śarīramākāśamayaṃ gaurave merumandarau
verses.translation: In its feathers, wind was established. In its end-point were the fire and the sun. In its heaviness were Mounts Meru and Mandara. Its shaft was made of ether.

glosses.meaning: were the fire and the sun

verses.devanagari:
जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा सुपुङ्खं हेमभूषितम् |
तेजसा सर्वभूतानां कृतं भास्करवर्चसम्
verses.iast:
jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā supuṇ^khaṃ hemabhūṣitam |
tejasā sarvabhūtānāṃ kṛtaṃ bhāskaravarcasam
verses.translation: Provided with good shaft decked with gold, the arrow which had its body shining, had been made up of the efficacy of all the elements and an illuminating power of the sun.

glosses.meaning: (the arrow) which had its body shining
of the efficacy of all the elements
and an illuminating power of the sun.

verses.devanagari:
सधूममिव कालाग्निं दीप्तमाशीविषोपमम् |
नरनागाश्ववृन्दानां भेदनं क्षिप्रकारिणम्
verses.iast:
sadhūmamiva kālāgniṃ dīptamāśīviṣopamam |
naranāgāśvavṛndānāṃ bhedanaṃ kṣiprakāriṇam
verses.translation: Blazing like a fire at the time of universal dissolution enveloped in smoke and looking like a venomous snake, it was swift in action and capable of bursting hosts of men, elephants and horses.

glosses.meaning: like a fire at the time of universal dissolution
and looking like a venomous snake

verses.devanagari:
द्वाराणां परिघाणां च गिरीणां चापि भेदनम् |
नानारुधिरदिग्धाङ्गं मेदोदिग्धं सुदारुणम्
verses.iast:
dvārāṇāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca girīṇāṃ cāpi bhedanam |
nānārudhiradigdhāṇ^gaṃ medodigdhaṃ sudāruṇam
verses.translation: It broke gate-ways, iron bars, and even mountains. Smeared witht he blood of various victims and quoted with their marrow, it presented a very terrific appearance.

glosses.meaning: smeared with the blood of various victims

verses.devanagari:
वज्रसारं महानादं नानासमितिदारणम् |
सर्ववित्रासनं भीमं श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम्
verses.iast:
vajrasāraṃ mahānādaṃ nānāsamitidāraṇam |
sarvavitrāsanaṃ bhīmaṃ śvasantamiva pannagam
verses.translation: That arrow had an efficacy of a thunder bolt, loud-sounding, tearing off armies of adversaries in many battles and creating fear to all, like a hissing serpent.

glosses.meaning: (It) had an efficacy of a thunder-bolt
It tore off various kinds of armies of adversaries (in many battles)

verses.devanagari:
कङ्कगृध्रबकानां च गोमायुगणरक्षसाम् |
नित्यं भक्षप्रदं युद्धे यमरूपं भयावहम्
verses.iast:
kaṇ^kagṛdhrabakānāṃ ca gomāyugaṇarakṣasām |
nityaṃ bhakṣapradaṃ yuddhe yamarūpaṃ bhayāvaham
verses.translation: It was giving perennial feed to vultures, eagles, cranes, troops of jackals and demons in the battle-field, possessing a form of Yama the lord of Death and was fearful.

glosses.meaning: it was in the form of Yama the lord of death

verses.devanagari:
नन्दनं वानरेन्द्राणां रक्षसामवसादनम् |
वाजितं विविधर्वाजैश्चारुचित्रैर्गरुत्मतः
verses.iast:
nandanaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ rakṣasāmavasādanam |
vājitaṃ vividharvājaiścārucitrairgarutmataḥ
verses.translation: That arrow bestowed joy on the monkey-leaders and destroyed the demons. It was made speedy, by tying various kinds of beautiful coloured feathers of Garuda, the king of eagles, to it.

glosses.meaning: by various kinds of beautiful coloured feathers

verses.devanagari:
तमुत्तमेषुम् लोकानामिक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् |
द्विषतां कीर्तिहरणम् प्रहर्षकरमात्मनः
अभिमन्त्र्य ततो रामस्तं महेषुं महाबलः |
वेदप्रोक्तेन विधिना संदधे कार्मुके बली
verses.iast:
tamuttameṣum lokānāmikṣvākubhayanāśanam |
dviṣatāṃ kīrtiharaṇam praharṣakaramātmanaḥ
abhimantrya tato rāmastaṃ maheṣuṃ mahābalaḥ |
vedaproktena vidhinā sandadhe kārmuke balī
verses.translation: Making it sacred by a special formula as per the procedure specified in scriptures, Rama who was endowed with an extraordinary strength then fixed that arrow which was the foremost among the three worlds, capable of removing the fear of Ikshwaku dynasty, taking away the glory of the enemies and bestowing joy to one's own self on his bow.

glosses.meaning: which removed the fear of Ikshwaku dynasty
making it sacred by a speacial formula
as per the procedure specified in the Vedas the sacred scripts.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् संधीयमाने तु राघवेण शरोत्तमे |
सर्वभूतानि संत्रेसुश्चचाल च वसुंधरा
verses.iast:
tasmin sandhīyamāne tu rāghaveṇa śarottame |
sarvabhūtāni santresuścacāla ca vasundharā
verses.translation: While that excellent arrow was being fixed by Rama, all the beings were frightened and the earth trembled.

verses.devanagari:
स रावणाय संक्रुद्धो भृशमायम्य कार्मुकम् |
चिक्षेप परमायत्तः शरं मर्मविदारणम्
verses.iast:
sa rāvaṇāya saṅkruddho bhṛśamāyamya kārmukam |
cikṣepa paramāyattaḥ śaraṃ marmavidāraṇam
verses.translation: That enraged Rama, stretching his bow well and with an attentive mind, hurled that arrow which can tear off the vitals, towards Ravana.

glosses.meaning: which can tear off the vitals

verses.devanagari:
स वज्र इव दुर्धर्षो वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः |
कृतान्त इव चावार्यो न्यपतद्रावणोरसि
verses.iast:
sa vajra iva durdharṣo vajribāhuvisarjitaḥ |
kṛtānta iva cāvāryo nyapatadrāvaṇorasi
verses.translation: That arrow, which was inviolable as a thunderbolt hurled by the arms of Indra and irresistible as Yama the lord of Death, fell upon Ravana's chest.

glosses.meaning: as Yama the lord of Death

verses.devanagari:
स विसृष्तो महावेगह् शरीरान्तकरः शरः |
च्छेद हृदयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
sa visṛṣto mahāvegah śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ |
ccheda hṛdayaṃ tasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
verses.translation: That arrow, released with great speed and which was capable of destroying the body, tore off the heart of that evil-minded Ravana.

glosses.meaning: and which was capable of destroying the body

verses.devanagari:
रुधिराक्तह् स वेगेन शरीरान्तकरः शरः |
रावणस्य हरन् प्राणान् विवेश धरणीतलम्
verses.iast:
rudhirāktah sa vegena śarīrāntakaraḥ śaraḥ |
rāvaṇasya haran prāṇān viveśa dharaṇītalam
verses.translation: That arrow, which was capable of causing death to the body, after taking away the life of Ravana and having been anointed with blood, penetrated the earth.

glosses.meaning: which was capable of causing death to the body

verses.devanagari:
स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्रीकृतच्छविः |
कृतकर्मा निभृतवत्स्वतूणीं पुनराविशत्
verses.iast:
sa śaro rāvaṇaṃ hatvā rudhirārrīkṛtacchaviḥ |
kṛtakarmā nibhṛtavatsvatūṇīṃ punarāviśat
verses.translation: Smeared with blood on having killed Ravana and thereby accomplishing its mission, that arrow re-entered its own quiver (of Rama) silently.

glosses.meaning: and the thereby accomplished its mission

verses.devanagari:
तस्य हस्तद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं च ससायकम् |
विपपात सह प्राणैर्भ्रुश्यमानस्य जीवितात्
verses.iast:
tasya hastaddhatasyāśu kārmukaṃ ca sasāyakam |
vipapāta saha prāṇairbhruśyamānasya jīvitāt
verses.translation: From the hands of the slain Ravana, who was being separated from his life, fell his bow with its arrows (fitted to it), at the same time coinciding indeed with his life-breath.

glosses.meaning: from the hands of the slain Ravana
who was being separated from his life

verses.devanagari:
गतासुर्भीमवेगस्तु नैरृतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः |
पपात स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा
verses.iast:
gatāsurbhīmavegastu nairṛtendro mahādyutiḥ |
papāta syandanādbhūmau vṛtro vajrahato yathā
verses.translation: Having lost his life, that king of demons for his part, who was endowed with terrible swiftness and invested with great splendour, fell down from the chariot to the ground , like Vritra the demon when the latter was struck down by the thunderbolt.

glosses.meaning: who was endowed with terrific swiftness

verses.devanagari:
तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ हतशेषा निशाचराः |
हतनाथा भयत्रस्ताः सर्वतः संप्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ |
hatanāthā bhayatrastāḥ sarvataḥ sampradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Ravana fallen down on earth, the surviving demons whose king had been killed, were panic stricken and ran away to all sides.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वतश्चाभिपेतुस्तान् वानरा द्रुमयोधिनः |
दशग्रीववधं दृष्ट्वा वानरा जितकाशिनः
verses.iast:
sarvataścābhipetustān vānarā drumayodhinaḥ |
daśagrīvavadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys, who fought with trees, fell upon the demons from all sides. Seeing the killing of Rvana, the monkeys assumed a triumphant appearance.

verses.devanagari:
अत्दिता वानरैर्भ्रष्टा लङ्कामभ्यपतन् भयात् |
हताश्रयत्वात्करुणैर्बाष्पप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः
verses.iast:
atditā vānarairbhraṣṭā laṇ^kāmabhyapatan bhayāt |
hatāśrayatvātkaruṇairbāṣpaprasravaṇairmukhaiḥ
verses.translation: Tormented by the monkeys, the demons rushed back with panic towards Lanka, with faces looking miserable and tears flowing down, their supporter having been killed.

glosses.meaning: the one on whom they depended

verses.devanagari:
ततो विनेदुः संहृष्टा वानरा जितकाशिनः |
वदन्तो राघवजयं रावणस्य च तद्वधम्
verses.iast:
tato vineduḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vānarā jitakāśinaḥ |
vadanto rāghavajayaṃ rāvaṇasya ca tadvadham
verses.translation: Roaring shouts of joy, quite rejoiced as they were, and proclaiming Rama's victory and the killing of Ravana in his hands, the monkeys behaved like conquerors.

verses.devanagari:
अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदत्सौम्य्स्त्रिदशदुन्दुभिः |
दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः सुसुखो ववौ
verses.iast:
athāntarikṣe vyanadatsaumystridaśadundubhiḥ |
divyagandhavahastatra mārutaḥ susukho vavau
verses.translation: Then the cheerful kettle-drum of the gods reverberated in the sky. Very pleasant winds, carrying divine odour, blew there.

verses.devanagari:
निपपातान्तरिक्षाच्च पुष्पवृष्टिस्तदा भुवि |
किरन्ती रघवरथं दुरवापा मनोहरा
verses.iast:
nipapātāntarikṣācca puṣpavṛṣṭistadā bhuvi |
kirantī raghavarathaṃ duravāpā manoharā
verses.translation: Pouring over the chariot of Rama quite fascinating shower of flowers, which was difficult to be accomplished (elsewhere), fell from the heavens to the earth on that occasion.

glosses.meaning: which was difficult to be accomplished

verses.devanagari:
राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता गगने च विशुश्रुवे |
साधु साध्विति वागग्य्रा देवतानां महात्मनाम्
verses.iast:
rāghavastavasaṃyuktā gagane ca viśuśruve |
sādhu sādhviti vāgagyrā devatānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Excellent pronouncements of the great-souled gods saying "well done! Bravo!", combined with a panegyric in praise of Rama, was distinctly heard in the sky.

glosses.meaning: combined with a panegyric in praise of Rama

verses.devanagari:
आविवेश महान् हर्षो देवानां चारणैः सह |
रावने निहते रौद्रे सर्वलोकभयंकरे
verses.iast:
āviveśa mahān harṣo devānāṃ cāraṇaiḥ saha |
rāvane nihate raudre sarvalokabhayaṅkare
verses.translation: When Ravana, the cruel demon and the terror of all the worlds, was killed, a great rejoice filled the hearts of gods and charanas the celestial bards.

glosses.meaning: the terror of all the world

verses.devanagari:
ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च विभीषणम् |
चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुंगवम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sakāmaṃ sugrīvamaṇ^gadaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam |
cakāra rāghavaḥ prīto hatvā rākṣasapuṅgavam
verses.translation: Having been pleased with the killing of Ravana, Rama then fulfilled the desire of Sugreeva, Angada and Vibhishana.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा |
दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभोऽभवत् |
मही चकम्पे न च मारुतो ववौ |
स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prajagmuḥ praśamaṃ marudgaṇā |
diśaḥ prasedurvimalaṃ nabho'bhavat |
mahī cakampe na ca māruto vavau |
sthiraprabhaścāpyabhavaddivākaraḥ
verses.translation: Then, troops of celestials got their mental peace. All the quarters were brightened up and the sky became clear. The earth did not tremble. The wind blew gently. The sun too shed a steady light.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु सुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाः |
सुहृद्विशिष्टाः सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा |
समेत्य हृष्टा विजयेन राघवं |
रणेऽभिरामं विधिनाभ्यपूजयन्
verses.iast:
tatastu sugrīvavibhīṣaṇāṇ^gadāḥ |
suhṛdviśiṣṭāḥ sahalakṣmaṇāstadā |
sametya hṛṣṭā vijayena rāghavaṃ |
raṇe'bhirāmaṃ vidhinābhyapūjayan
verses.translation: Rejoiced with the victory in battle, Sugreeva, Vibhishana and Angada together with Lakshmana along with their friends paid their respects with due ceremony to Rama, who looked charming.

verses.devanagari:
स तु निहररिपुह् स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः |
स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे रराज |
रघुकुलनृपनन्दनो महुजा |
स्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो यथेन्द्रः
verses.iast:
sa tu nihararipuh sthirapratijJṇaḥ |
svajanabalābhivṛto raṇe rarāja |
raghukulanṛpanandano mahujā |
stridaśagaṇairabhisaṃvṛto yathendraḥ
verses.translation: That Rama, the delight of Dasaratha, for his part, who had just killed his enemy and thus who was steadfast in his vows and who was endowed with a great splendour, who stood surrounded on the battle-field by his own people and the army shone like Indra the lord of celestials.

glosses.meaning: who had just killed his enemy

glosses.itrans: who was steadfast in his vows. mahaatejaaH
glosses.iast: vho vas steadfast in his vovs. mahātejāḥ
glosses.devanagari: व्हो वस् स्तेअद्fअस्त् इन् हिस् वोव्स्. महातेजाः
glosses.meaning: and who was endowed with a great splendour
who stood surrounded on the battle-field by his own people and the army
like Indra the lord of celestials.
